brewpage.description: BrewPage remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, no account or API key). Free: no paid plans, no sign-up needed. Tools publish HTML pages, Markdown, JSON documents, key-value data and files to brewpage.app and return a shareable HTTPS link, plus an owner token to update or delete them. Content is temporary (expires, up to 30 days). Docs: https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/
